import timeit, struct
data = bytes(1000000)
U32 = struct.Struct(">I")
def f1():
    p = 0; total = 0
    for _ in range(100000):
        total += int.from_bytes(data[p:p+4], "big"); p += 4
    return total
def f2():
    p = 0; total = 0
    up = U32.unpack_from
    for _ in range(100000):
        total += up(data, p)[0]; p += 4
    return total
print("slice", timeit.timeit(f1, number=5))
print("struct", timeit.timeit(f2, number=5))
PYEOF
